versions.changelog:
- Initial release of alibabacloud-oss-crr-config-check.
- Provides read-only checks of Alibaba Cloud OSS cross-region replication (CRR) configurations.
- Inspects replication rule presence, authorization role, prefix scope, delete-marker and historical-data sync, and possible cold archive/transfer acceleration misconfigurations.
- Responds to triggers like “replication not starting”, config errors, authorization, and replication investigation plans.
- Enforces strict read-only and evidence-based reporting; never creates or modifies configurations.
- Includes mandatory use of provided scripts for all queries and doc verification with official URLs only.
